body:
Real, working DEFLATE decompressor in PARENA: bit reader, canonical Huffman construct+decode (puff.c's real table-free algorithm, chosen since Vec has no indexed set!), all 3 block types, LZ77 copying. Compiles cleanly (parena build + gcc-verified emitted C). Tested against real zlib-generated vectors: stored/fixed-Huffman/one dynamic-Huffman case/long-backref repeats all decode byte-for-byte correctly. One further dynamic-Huffman case (level-9 text) hangs -- isolated via a Python port of the identical algorithm, which decodes the SAME case correctly, proving this is a VS0 C-emitter codegen bug (inflate-huffman-block's pos/opos loop state infers as C double instead of I32, unlike every structurally-identical loop elsewhere in the file), not an algorithm bug. Deliberately not wired into SHANKPIT yet -- real follow-up once found. Commit PARENA 1fc82ae.

⚓ ☃
title: Real RFC 1951 DEFLATE inflate decoder -- working, but one known codegen bug blocks SHANKPIT integration
